label: Iresini
rs.resin.note: Izinombolo zokuveza nokuphakamisa ziyisiqalo salolu hlobo lweresini, hhayi eyakho. Sebenzisa ukuhlolwa kokuveza okusezansi ukuze uthole eyakho.
rs.printer.note: Iskrini {w} × {h} amapiksela, {x} × {y} mm. Lezi yizinkulumo ezipapashwe ngumenzi: hlola eyakho uyihlele ku-Custom.
rs.supports.note: Ingxenye iphakanyiswa phezu kwerafu, futhi yonke indawo ebheke phansi, ukuphuma kanye nesiqeqeshana esintantayo kuthola izinsika ezincane. Lezi zisekelo zintsha futhi azikaze zizanywe kuphrinta: bheka izingqimba ngaphambi kokuphrinta.
rs.noformat: Akukafakwa ifomethi yefayela yale phrinta. Yengeze ngezansi.
rs.format.unlisted: {printer} akubhalwanga njengefunda leli fomethi. Yisebenzise kuphela uma wazi ukuthi iphrinta yakho iyifunda.
rs.format.options: Uma iphrinta yakho yenqaba ifayela, shintsha enye yalezi bese uyilondoloza futhi, bese usitshela ukuthi yiphi eyasebenza.
rs.preview.stale: Isisekelo noma izilungiselelo zishintshile kusukela ekuhlukaniseni okwedlule. Bona izingqimba futhi.
rs.stats: Izingqimba {layers}, cishe {time}, {ml} mL weresini ({g} g, cishe {cost}).
rs.off: Ngaphandle kweskrini: {names}. Yihambise ngaphakathi komugqa oqoshiwe.
rs.confirm.untested: Leli fayela lifundwe yi-CadCraft kuphela. Akukalayishwa kuphrinta: hlola izingqimba bese uqala ukuphrinta ngesandla.
rs.saved: Kulondoloziwe {name}: cishe {time}, {ml} mL weresini. Kopisha kuphrinta.
rs.untested: Kusha kulokhu kwakha. Amafayela awakadlulisi kuphrinta.
rs.warn.skipped: Izingcezu {n} ({share}% yesimo) azisona izinqe ezivaliwe futhi zishiyiwe.
rs.warn.skipped_one: Ingcezu eyodwa ({share}% yesimo) ayisona isinqe esivaliwe futhi yashiywa.
rs.warn.sheets: Amaphaneli amancane {n} anikezwe ubukhulu ukuze aphrintwe.
rs.warn.floating: Isimo sasiphakame phezu kwephleti; sehliselwe kiyo.
rs.warn.islands: Izingcezu {n} azinalutho phansi kwazo futhi zizowa. Vula izisekelo, noma uthambise isimo.
rs.warn.overhangs: Okuphuma kwezingqimba {n} kuthambe kakhulu kunekona esethiwe, ngaphandle kwezisekelo.
rs.warn.nodrain: Izikhala ezivaliwe {n} zehlulekile ukuthola imbobo. Yenza udonga lube lulincane noma imbobo ibe mincane.
